decision_rationale: The record describes a new P3GPT model trained on omics data with an auxiliary modality extension for biomedical texts and KGs, not a review or wrapper. The text embeddings are mapped into the language model latent space and are used with prompt instructions, supporting a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "The auxiliary component enriches P3GPT with multimodal data... MMs take in embeddings from additional modalities-biomedical texts and KGs-and map them onto the language model's latent space"; "prompt format... instructions"
